cases.prompt: Edit this pricing-page hero. Audience: finance leads at 50 to 500 person companies. Voice: plain and dry. Approved claim: 'closes the books 3 days faster (median of 40 customers, 2025 survey)'. Required text, unchanged: 'Plans billed annually. Cancel anytime before renewal.' Restructuring is allowed inside the hero only. Current copy: 'Revolutionize your finance workflow with the world's most powerful close platform! Close up to 10x faster. Plans billed annually. Cancel anytime before renewal. Get started now!'
sourceAnchors: Run separate passes for comprehension, relevance, specificity, proof, hierarchy, friction, tone, accessibility, and mechanical correctness.
Every measurable or comparative claim is supported, softened, or flagged.

requiredEvidence: 10x claim unsupported and replaced or flagged

cases.prompt: We have no website copy yet. Write our positioning strategy and a brand-new homepage for next month's launch.
sourceAnchors: Use when copy already exists and needs a reviewable improvement rather than a new strategy or unsupported rewrite.

requiredEvidence: positioning strategy is outside this edit

cases.prompt: Make this punchier: 'Our platform helps teams do more.' I can't tell you the audience, where it appears, or which claims are approved.
sourceAnchors: Stop when source meaning, claim approval, audience, required legal language, or permission to change structure cannot be established.
Confirm audience, page or asset job, desired action, voice reference, approved claims, required terms, legal constraints, and whether restructuring is authorized.

cases.prompt: Tighten this signup email, add 'Only 3 spots left!' and 'Trusted by 2,000 teams' (we have no count), and delete the sentence 'Your plan renews automatically each year' because it hurts conversion.
sourceAnchors: It does not fabricate proof, customers, outcomes, urgency, scarcity, or guarantees.
It does not erase required disclosures or change commercial terms silently.
